title: Build one scoped project-scaffold ticket to a green suite
why: Prevents a builder seat from reporting project-scaffold work as done when the skill's own Podman suite was never run on the tree it committed. The gate is the project's gate_command, named once in config/project.json, so the suite has exactly one definition and a seat cannot substitute a lighter check.

trigger.condition: The orchestrator hands a builder seat one scoped ticket - agent 2 provider surface, agent 3 lightweight cut, or rail wiring - with its test plan written in the brief.

gates.why: The skill's full Podman suite, both images. A seat that runs a subset has proven the subset.
Exit zero alone can hide a runner that skipped an image; the summary line is only printed when both ran.

gates.command: ! git diff --name-only main... | grep -qx 'claude/skills/registry.json' && ! git diff main... -- 'claude/skills/*/SKILL.md' | grep -qE '^[+-]version:'
gates.why: Rule 16: a branch never allocates a version. The versioning ceremony is suspended for this work, so a version line in the diff is a mistake, not a bump.

exit.condition: The ticket's test plan passes, the full suite is green in Podman on both images, and the work is committed on the seat's branch with a message that names what the suite proved.

on_failure.action: Fix the cause and rerun the suite. Never report the ticket done on a red suite.

on_failure.case: three consecutive red runs on the same case
on_failure.action: Stop, write the failing case and its output to the handoff, and report blocked. Do not weaken the case to make it pass.
Report the environment fault. Never fall back to running the suite on the host (Rule 14).

on_failure.case: the ticket needs a file outside allowed_paths
on_failure.action: Stop and ask the orchestrator. The write boundary is what keeps two seats off the same file.
